description: Defines the CampaignTracker class for managing campaign tracking data in SuiteCRM, extending SugarBean, including properties, save logic, and detail filling.

classes.name: CampaignTracker
classes.description: A class extending SugarBean to handle campaign tracking data, including properties for tracking info, methods for saving with URL correction, and filling additional details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CampaignTracker object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to ensure the tracker URL has a proper scheme unless it's an opt-out.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the tracker name as a summary string for navigation purposes.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates campaign name and message URL based on related campaign data and admin settings.
